description: Risk and hope are held together through institutions repair and democratic action.
Dread is high while agency trust and repair remain weak.
Optimism remains high but accountability and repair are weak.
Fear politics intensifies polarization and weakens agency.
Crisis fatigue erodes trust and participation.
Youth-led action converts intergenerational emotion into agency.
Hope is high but weakly grounded in accountability or repair.
Hope is grounded in repair memory community authority and ecological care.
